newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit seen in narrow range vs dlr, awaits data.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit seen in narrow range vs dlr, awaits data.

text.p: The ringgit was expected to trade narrowly with big local banks seen supporting it from making a sharp drop, dealers said.
The stable dollar/majors and vigil of Malaysian economic data would confine the currency's range, they added.
"Today it's going to be in a tight range. There's not much on the topside" for dollar/ringgit, said a Malaysian bank dealer.
After rumours that Bank Negara Malaysia was checking ringgit-rates on Wednesday, players may be wary at pushing the currency in a wide band in a newsless day, a Singapore-based analyst said.
Vigil continues for Malaysia's first quarter gross domestic product data (GDP) and the April monetary supply numbers, which could give clues on the country's interest rate direction.
Economists said they expect the first quarter GDP data of around 8.0-8.2 percent. "I think there shouldn't be any surprises," said an economist at an investment house in Singapore.
